mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM camoufox_login_states WHERE shop_id=#{shop} AND invalidated_at IS NULL)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO camoufox_login_states (shop_id,platform_shop_id,account_id,encrypted_state,revision,updated_at,invalidated_at) VALUES (#{shop},#{platformShop},#{account},#{scope},#{value},#{now},NULL) ON CONFLICT (shop_id) DO UPDATE SET platform_shop_id=EXCLUDED.platform_shop_id, account_id=EXCLUDED.account_id, encrypted_state=EXCLUDED.encrypted_state, revision=EXCLUDED.revision, updated_at=EXCLUDED.updated_at, invalidated_at=NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE camoufox_login_states SET encrypted_state=#{scope},revision=#{value},updated_at=#{now} WHERE shop_id=#{shop} AND revision=#{revision} AND invalidated_at IS NULL
UPDATE camoufox_login_states SET invalidated_at=#{now} WHERE shop_id=#{shop} AND revision=#{revision}
